描述_ZN: This inkstone box is modeled after a stack of Japanese books of "Eika Monogatari" (The Tale of Eika). Attention to detail can be seen in the seven stacked booklets, each of which has a different thickness. Eika Monogatari" is a historical book from the late Heian period that depicts the life of the Heian aristocrats in a narrative style, focusing on the prosperity of Fujiwara no Michinaga (966-1028) and Yorimichi (992-1071). The white glazed ground is inscribed "Eika Monogatari Goga" (Tales of Eika: Goga) in rust color, the gauze ground is painted in navy blue, and chrysanthemums are painted in red, green, and gold. This type of colored pottery is generally referred to as koshimizu. However, the colors are not extremely rich. The chrysanthemum design on the lid is openwork. No markings or inscriptions can be seen.
